options.label: Use GPS Elevations
options.description: Use elevation data from the original track as recored by the GPS device.

options.label: Use API Elevations
options.description: Fetch more accurate elevation data sourced from a global land dataset. Makes processing take longer, increases website load time, and not really needed since GPS is more than enough.

title: Default Basemap
description: Choose your preferred default basemap for the map view.

title: Replace Icons with Points at Low Zoom
description: Replace custom icons with colored default points when zoomed out. This helps make features more visible when you're zoomed out.

title: 3D Terrain Enabled by Default
description: When enabled, 3D terrain will be turned on by default when you load the map. You can still toggle it on/off using the map control button.

title: Hillshade Enabled by Default
description: When enabled, hillshade will be turned on by default when you load the map. You can still toggle it on/off using the map control.

title: Enable Anti-Aliasing
description: Enable anti-aliasing for smoother map rendering. This makes lines and edges appear smoother but may have a slight performance impact.

title: Overwrite Single Track Name with Filename
description: When a file contains a single track feature, overwrite the track name with the filename.

title: Show Debug Logs
description: Show DEBUG level logs in the import process page

title: Units
description: Choose your preferred unit system for distances and measurements.
